   278	            .get("billable")
   279	            .and_then(|b| b.as_bool())
   280	            .unwrap_or(false);
   281	
   282	        // Time entries can be nested
   283	        if let Some(time_entries) = entry.get("time_entries").and_then(|te| te.as_array()) {
   284	            for te in time_entries {
   285	                let seconds = te.get("seconds").and_then(|s| s.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0);
   286	                let start = te.get("start").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
   287	
   288	                total_seconds += seconds;
   289	                entry_count += 1;
   290	
   291	                print_detailed_entry(start, seconds, billable, description, project_name);
   292	            }
   293	        } else {
   294	            // Flat structure: seconds directly on the entry
   295	            let seconds = entry.get("seconds").and_then(|s| s.as_i64()).unwrap_or(0);
   296	            let start = entry.get("start").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
   297	            total_seconds += seconds;
   298	            entry_count += 1;
   299	
   300	            print_detailed_entry(start, seconds, billable, description, project_name);
   301	        }
   302	    }
   303	
   304	    println!("{}", "-".repeat(70));
   305	    println!(
   306	        "  {} {} ({} entries)",
   307	        format_duration_hms(total_seconds).green().bold(),
   308	        "Total".bold(),
   309	        entry_count,
   310	    );
   311	}
   312	
   313	fn print_detailed_entry(
   314	    start: &str,
   315	    seconds: i64,
   316	    billable: bool,
   317	    description: &str,
   318	    project_name: &str,
   319	) {
   320	    let duration = format_duration_hms(seconds);
   321	    let billable_marker = if billable { "$" } else { " " };
   322	    let project_display = if project_name.is_empty() {
   323	        String::new()
   324	    } else {
   325	        format!(" @{}", project_name.cyan())
   326	    };
   327	    let date_display = if start.len() >= 10 {
   328	        &start[..10]
   329	    } else {
   330	        start
   331	    };
   332	
   333	    println!(
   334	        "{} {} [{}] {}{}",
   335	        billable_marker.green().bold(),
   336	        date_display.dimmed(),
   337	        duration.green(),
   338	        description,
   339	        project_display,
   340	    );

text: This checkout has no `toggl entry bill` command or billing-rate conversion. A time entry is simply marked `billable: true` (via `entry start --billable` or `entry edit --billable`); reports still use the recorded duration in seconds and display the billable marker, without converting it into money or separate billable hours.
